opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. William K. Jackson and Mr. John L. Doggett for petitioner. Mr. A. H. King, -Mr. Roewell King and Mr. George C. Bedell for respondent.
